Title: Use Erciyes to discard a prey's combat card and activate Haqim's Law Retribution

Messages.Author: Spind
Messages.Body:
Hey folks! Question: Considering the rule
Can be used during an action, when the controller has the opportunity to play an effect. [ANK 20200616]
of Erciyes Fragments, can I use it to get a combat card from my prey's ash heap and discard it to get +1 bleed with Haqim's Law: Retribution?
Considering that Erciyes says that you can Play as if it were in you hand.

The Erciyes Fragments

Haqim's Law: Retribution

Messages.Author: DavidR
Messages.Body:
You can play the card as if it was on your hand, discard is not play the card, so i think you can't

Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
> Spind wrote:
> So, the ruling that says that the card can play an *effect*, the "discard a card" cannot be considered the effect in question, correct?
>
To discard a card you must have a card in your hand.

When you have a card on erciyes fragment, the card is never in your hand even if you can play it from the fragment.

Messages.Author: Hobbesgoblin
Messages.Body:
> Spind wrote:
> So, the ruling that says that the card can play an *effect*, the "discard a card" cannot be considered the effect in question, correct?
>
There seems to be a fundamental misunderstanding regarding the original ruling here, I just realised.

"Use" in this case is meant as "you can lock the fragments to fetch a card from your preys ash heap at any time you could use an effect"
it has nothing to do with the ability to play the card that is on the fragments.
The timing on when to play the card on the fragment is entirely defined by the card itself.
